A little about me.

I'm a final-year Computer Science Engineering student at Jyothy Institute of Technology, Bengaluru, currently holding a 9.32 CGPA. Most of what I know, I've learned by building — rental platforms, gesture-controlled dashboards, recipe recommenders — and then figuring out why they broke.

I care about software engineering that's practical: systems that hold up, backends that make sense, and interfaces people actually enjoy using. Lately I've been spending more time with AI-powered applications and cloud tooling, and I like that there's always another layer to learn.
